195338.overview: Elevator Game is a pretty simple game in which your goal is to save the girl at the top of the building before she jumps to her death. You have 5 men to accomplish this and you’ll lose one each time you miss stepping into the next elevator. If you run out of lives you’ll naturally get a game over, but you can also get one if she jumps to her death and you don’t reach her on the top floor or catch her successfully from the ground level if she jumps.

206984.overview: Unrelated to the popular SNES RPG, Earthbound is an adventure game developed by XtalSoft in 1983.
